sys_atf_test.description: Sends two sequential POSTs to /case with the same torq_incident_id (ATF-UPSERT-001). The first POST creates the case (asserts 201 + result.status=created), and the second POST updates the existing case (asserts 200 + result.status=updated), validating the upsert behavior.
sys_atf_test.name: API - POST Upsert Existing Case (200)
